Scouting Desk: light, compact and zoomed

DG05-CONCEPT-B1 extends the selected direction A (a table with a docked player inspector). These are static design frames, not the app: nothing here generates, imports or exports, and the focus states are drawn, not produced by keyboard input.

Data in the frames. Names, draft selections, colleges, source positions and the Bob Brown correction are real identity facts from a local import. wAV, evidence states and career numbers are ◇ sample inputs, not any player's record; OVR, dev tier and percentile are illustrative values computed from those samples, identical to concept A's. Lens, hindsight and seed are example settings, not chosen defaults.

Keyboard focus (state concept)

Selection = row tint + 4px accent bar on the left edge + bold player name, and the inspector shows that player (aria-selected). Focus = a 2px ring in a blue focus colour around the whole row or control. The two use different shapes (edge bar vs enclosing ring), so neither depends on hue; the greyscale crops above show both survive without colour. Focus colour is the same blue family in both themes, separate from the theme accent.

Proposed tab sequence (one stop per region; arrows move inside a region; F6 cycles regions):

  1. Skip link “Skip to board” (visible on focus)
  2. View rail (one stop; ↑/↓ between views)
  3. Class context chips (one stop; ←/→ between chips; Enter opens a chip's popover)
  4. Toolbar: Search → Filters → Sort → Columns → Spoilers → Generate… → Validate & export…
  5. Board grid (one stop, roving focus): ↑/↓ moves focus and selection; Ctrl+↑/↓ moves focus only; Space selects the focused row; Home/End, PgUp/PgDn; Enter moves into the inspector
  6. Inspector: tabs (←/→ at 200% zoom) or disclosure headers, then links such as “View evidence”; Esc returns focus to the selected row
  7. Status bar links (Overflow, unsettled IDs); counts themselves are read-only text

Not tested: nothing was exercised with a keyboard or a screen reader. The frames carry roles (grid, switch, tablist, aria-selected) as annotations only.

Original dev-trait icons

Bytes from AMattHT/Madden-Draft-Generator server/data/dev-icons/ at 9a4ac69, hashes checked at build time; mapping from ui.tsx, not file names. EA artwork used at the user's request; never redrawn or recoloured. Every icon keeps its text label and alt. The share column is the fraction of each icon's opaque pixels that reach 3:1 against what it sits on: in dark, a neutral backing chip lifts it from 14–34% to 62–85%. Light needs no chip.
